chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far narrated to me from his father, from Harun ibn Muslim, from 'Ali ibn Hassan al-Wasiti, from some of our companions, from al-Rida (peace be upon him), regarding going to the grave of Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him).
He said: 'Establish prayers in the mosques around it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended prayer practice at the grave of Imam al-Kazim according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies that the mosques surrounding the shrine of Imam Musa al-Kazim (peace be upon him) in Baghdad are to be treated as integral parts of the sacred precinct, thereby validating congregational prayers within them. This ruling underscores the theological significance of the Imam's burial site as a locus of worship, distinguishing it from mere visitation spots and affirming the continuity of ritual practice in proximity to the Ahl al-Bayt.
